item.name: Black Water Night Dive
item.description:
#Are you an adventurous person looking for a more advanced dive? 

Don't see dates that work for you? Try booking with [our excellent partner company.](https://fareharbor.com/embeds/book/aquaticlifedivers/items/477993/?schedule-uuid=7d264b1e-9965-4d82-b895-ec0199f2760c&asn=konahonudivers&full-items=yes&flow=2692)

##Duration 
3 hours
6:15-9:15pm

##Description
Blackwater diving is a unique night dive which will take you miles offshore where you will hang, suspended from a 60ft tether, over 4000ft of water to watch open ocean, or pelagic, animals drift by. You’ll have the opportunity to see animals ranging from perfectly clear larval fish and invertebrates to siphonophores, and even cephalopods out in the deep. If you want to observe something you have never seen before, this is the dive for you. 

#Inclusions
Informative dive briefing
Tanks, weights, dive light

#Dive Requirements
* This dive is for the confident diver that has excellent buoyancy skills and is self-reliant
* You must have at least 50 logged dives to join us on this adventurous dive
* You must have been diving within the last 6 months
* You must be in good health and have NO heart conditions
* You must be able to converse in English
* 18 or older - under 18 considered with a JOW Rescue Diver Certification
* You must remember there are other guests onboard that are looking for a premium experience so our standards MUST be met. Kindly be a responsible and considerate diver and respect these standards.



All activities will be charged Sales Tax (4.712%), Harbor Use Fee (3%), $1 Conservation Fee & Booking Fee (5%)
item.booking_notes:
Now that you have reserved your diving with us it is important to thoroughly understand all the information below.  This will help ensure that you are prepared and that your experience will be enjoyable from start to finish.  Kindly, be sure to pass this information along to EVERYONE in your party.  If you have any further questions or need clarification of any of the information below, feel free to call us at (808) 324-4668.  

Mahalo nui loa and enjoy your tour!

###WAIVERS
Your waivers will be sent in a separate email or your can click [this link](https://web.wherewolf.co.nz/drwazc)! 

###Diving & Altitude
The following guidelines are the consensus of attendees at the 2002 Flying After Diving Workshop. They apply to air dives followed by flights at cabin altitudes of 2,000 to 8,000 feet (610 to 2,438 meters) for divers who do not have symptoms of decompression sickness (DCS). The recommended preflight surface intervals do not guarantee avoidance of DCS. Longer surface intervals will reduce DCS risk further. 

For a single no-decompression dive, a minimum preflight surface interval of 12 hours is suggested. 

For multiple dives per day or multiple days of diving, a minimum preflight surface interval of 18 hours is suggested. 

*Keep in mind that many of the roads around the island exceed 2,000ft. It is the diver's responsibility to know the altitude of their accommodations and the routes to get there.*

Read this for [Responsible & Considerate Diver Etiquette](https://konahonudivers.com/responsible-considerate-diver-etiquette/)


##Tips

-  **Be on time.** Transportation is not included. Do not underestimate driving time. Morning traffic conditions are quite congested and slow moving, especially if you are staying South of Kailua-Kona and driving North to the harbor. **It is your responsibility to arrive on time and follow the start time provided in this email.** We reserve the right to leave at our scheduled departure time 

- **You must be able to present your dive card prior to boarding the vessel** - physical or ecard. It is *your* responsibility to show proof of certification. If you do not have your certification card and cannot provide proof of being certified we will not take you diving and no refund will be issued.

- **If it has been more than 2 years since your last dive, we require you to take a refresher course. If it has been more than 5 years we require a PADI ReActivate. If it has been more than 10 years, we require you to take the open water course again. This is for YOUR safety! Falsifying this information can lead to serious injury or death.**

- **Wear sun-protective clothing instead of sunscreen.** Only mineral sunscreens are permitted aboard our vessels.  As lovers of the ocean kindly be stewards of the ocean.  If we see you using toxic sunscreen you will be asked to put it away.

- **Bring a reusable water bottle**

- **If you are prone to seasickness, we strongly recommend taking Bonine!**

- **Please contact us before your charter if you have special diving needs so that we can best accommodate you.** We are unable to accommodate sidemount diving at this time.

- **If there are certain dive sites you have your heart set on we recommend private chartering the [Honu Lele](https://www.konahonudivers.com/kona-charter-boat.htm).**

- **We reserve the right to refuse service, with no refund, if you have booked and have ignored our expected safety standards outlined on our website and during the reservation process.**  

- **We reserve the right to refuse service if we feel it is unsafe for you to participate in this activity for any reason.**  

- **We reserve the right to cancel your dives if you are not respectful of the safety guidelines, the reef, and wildlife.**

**We highly recommend each diver carry dive insurance.**
[![Description of image](https://cdn.filestackcontent.com/dYpQeCAGRfSi6yr6e5Ht)](https://bit.ly/dan-dive-insurance)

You meet directly at the boat.  DO NOT come to the shop.  We do not provide transportation to the boat.

Parking is free in the Harbor.  Look for our boat with our logo in the parking lot near the boat launch and public restroom on the NORTH SIDE of Honokohau Harbor.  Pull up to the boat to drop your dive gear and then park your car.

**RENTING A VEHICLE IS NECESSARY, TRY TURO (Air BnB for cars), TAXIS & UBERS ARE CURRENTLY NOT RELIABLE FORMS OF TRANSPORTATION**
